name: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Ltd
title: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Ltd - 544512 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mangalsutra maker guides ~30% value CAGR for 2-3 years, but FY26 capacity use was 87% on a mid-year expansion to 4,000 kg, while working capital absorbed cash and FCF was negative.

utilisation.quote: leading to an effective capacity utilization of 87% for FY '26

capex.quote: we executed a major expansion of our manufacturing capabilities during the fourth quarter, resulting in a meaningful increase in production capacity from 2,500 kgs to 4,000 kgs

triggers.label: FY26 utilisation 87% on 2,625 kg blended
triggers.quote: leading to an effective capacity utilization of 87% for FY '26

triggers.label: Working capital absorbs cash, no FCF
triggers.quote: no free cash flow was generated because a significant portion of the funds was absorbed by working capital requirements

triggers.label: 30% value CAGR for 2-3 years
triggers.quote: we remain committed to our guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years

triggers.label: Job-work to outright shift with Tata, Birla
triggers.quote: if we were to convert this into outright sales, it could potentially reach INR70 crores to INR80 crores

guidance.quote: we remain committed to our guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years
Within this year, we will increase our mangalsutra sales by one-third, i.e., approximately 33% to 35%
Within approximately two quarters, we will have converted a significant portion of our operations

red_flags.label: Negative FCF from working capital build
red_flags.quote: no free cash flow was generated because a significant portion of the funds was absorbed by working capital requirements

red_flags.label: Hedging notional loss in P&L
red_flags.quote: The biggest difference, if any, is the hedging notional loss.

red_flags.label: Management evasion on working capital days
red_flags.quote: Ma'am, right now I am working with 1,333 customers.

evasions.quote: Ma'am, right now I am working with 1,333 customers.
we cannot compare Titan with them because Titan is completely based on job work
